_comment: Security rules over Authentik's events (ADR-050). Rendered only while the site's security monitoring is on.

rules.name: authentik-login-bf
rules.title: AuthentikLoginBruteForce
rules.headline: Authentik login brute force
rules._comment: Authentik's events are JSON lines in the journal (identity.nix).
rules.summary: More than ten failed sign-ins from one address in ten minutes. CrowdSec bans the address at the firewall on Authentik's token endpoint; this covers the sign-in flow too.

rules.name: authentik-suspicious
rules.title: AuthentikSuspiciousRequest
rules.headline: Authentik suspicious request
rules.summary: Authentik flagged a request as suspicious (a reputation policy, a malformed or replayed request).

rules.name: authentik-impersonation
rules.title: AuthentikImpersonation
rules.headline: Authentik impersonation
rules.summary: An administrator started impersonating a user in Authentik. Expected only when someone is helping that user.
